{{Top|leg}}
The '''Museum of Antiquities''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a shipment of rare art sent to the museum was intercepted; the valuable art was replaced with worthless copies of the paintings made by the famous commercial artist [[Ornas Lodin]].<ref name="Art">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Getting in on the Art Trade}}</ref>
